definition.en: Capital Account Convertibility refers to the freedom to convert local financial assets into foreign financial assets and vice versa at market-determined exchange rates.
definition.hi: Capital Account Convertibility refers to the freedom to convert local financial assets into foreign financial assets and vice versa at market-determined exchange rates.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is critical for UPSC GS-3 as it relates to India's external sector stability, foreign investment policies, and the role of the RBI in managing capital flows. Understanding the balance between liberalization and economic stability is a frequent theme in Mains examinations.
